purpose: Machine-readable state for exploratory trial localization. This file is for agents and scripts, not human translation review.

policy.strategy: Probe discovered display candidates with fast-fail batch smoke tests, then keep accepted entries in normal rewrite maps.
policy.passScope: A trial pass proves build, install, startup, and the trial runner's explicit -IncludeNewGame smoke safety only. It does not prove wording, layout, hover coverage, fixed-save loading, or all UI paths.
policy.csvOriginalRule: Do not use an on-demand known-texts view Original as an IL rewrite Original. It is normalized for review. Use the exact DLL catalog Value.
policy.skipPolicy: Keep SkippedByPolicy for technical/internal text, semantic-free grammar glue, date/season logic, external online flows, raw IDs, paths, parser match tokens, bracket-only parser-like tags, and static config candidates classified as unsafe.
forbiddenTrialInputs: bracket-only parser-like tokens such as [Active] or [HILL:S]
entries whose Original or Translation contains U+FFFD replacement characters

batchSizing.failureAdjustment: If a batch fails, bisect. If more than one bad entry is found in the batch, halve the next batch size for that source class.
